SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.project_status AS projectStatus, p.deadline_date AS deadlineDate, p.applicant_count AS applicantCount, p.created_at AS createdAt,
-- 지급 요청 여부 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract_milestones cm JOIN contracts c ON cm.contract_id = c.contract_id JOIN project_applications pa ON c.contract_id = pa.application_id WHERE pa.project_id = p.project_id AND cm.status = 'REQUESTED') > 0 AS hasPaymentRequest,
(SELECT c.client_rating FROM contracts c JOIN project_applications pa ON c.contract_id = pa.application_id WHERE pa.project_id = p.project_id LIMIT 1) AS clientRating
FROM projects p WHERE p.client_id = #{clientId}
AND p.project_status = 'READY'
AND p.project_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
AND p.project_status = 'CLOSED'
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
